subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should be visible to channel users, and how should session or channel identifiers be redacted?
rationale: The code already has model, token, route, and session facts, but exposing raw identifiers and exact counts changes privacy and support behavior that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Show redacted diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget, estimated or observed token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep details operator-only
options.body: Leave channel copy generic and document how operators can inspect logs or status metadata for the detailed context-pressure facts.

options.title: Defer to broader context visibility
options.body: Keep this open until a broader context-visibility design covers logs, channel messages, status surfaces, and compaction notifications together.

recommendation.title: Show redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget, estimated or observed token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.
